quizzes.title: BRICS 2026 Summit Overview
quizzes.passage: India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi in 2026, a year in which the country held the grouping's chairship for the fourth time. The chairship ran under the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability.' The 2026 calendar also included several ministerial and sectoral meetings held in different Indian cities. The meetings covered urbanisation, energy, transport, friendship between cities and the work of chief justices. The programme of meetings ran across several months of the year, with dates spread from June to September 2026. The host cities listed for these meetings span more than one Indian state. Each meeting formed part of India's role as chair, which covered financial, scientific, health and security cooperation among member countries. The outcomes were grouped under several headings. These included financial, economic and trade cooperation, taxation and customs cooperation, agriculture and food security, health and medicine, transport, logistics and climate cooperation, security, law and social cooperation, culinary diplomacy, and geopolitical mandates with global governance. India also showcased regional products during the summit itself, as part of its culinary diplomacy. The year also marked 25 years since the BRIC concept first emerged. Earlier Indian chairships had taken place on several occasions before 2026.

questions.q: At which venue was the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit held in New Delhi?
questions.explanation: The booklet lists the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit as held in New Delhi at Bharat Mandapam.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The New Delhi Declaration was adopted unanimously at the close of the 18th BRICS Summit.
Reason (R): The declaration emphasised multilateralism and greater representation of the Global South.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
A is false but R is true.
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
questions.explanation: Both statements are booklet facts, but the emphasis on multilateralism does not explain the unanimous adoption.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Resilience   ->   A. Dealing with economic, environmental and geopolitical challenges
II. Innovation   ->   B. New technologies, research and digital solutions for development
III. Cooperation   ->   C. Collaboration among BRICS countries in different sectors
IV. Sustainability   ->   D. Environmentally sustainable and inclusive economic growth
questions.explanation: Each theme word matches its booklet definition: resilience with challenges, innovation with technologies, cooperation with collaboration, and sustainability with growth.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the 2026 meetings:
I. The BRICS Energy Ministers' Meeting was held in Gurugram, Haryana.
II. The BRICS Friendship Cities Conclave was held in Nagpur, Maharashtra.
III. The BRICS Transport Ministers' Meeting was the third of its kind.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: The Energy meeting was in Gurugram and the Transport meeting was the 3rd, while the Friendship Cities Conclave was held in Mumbai.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The BRICS Urbanisation Forum was the 13th of its kind.
II. The BRICS Energy Ministers' Meeting was the 12th of its kind.
III. The BRICS Transport Ministers' Meeting was the 3rd of its kind.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation: The Urbanisation Forum was the 13th and the Transport meeting the 3rd, while the Energy meeting was the 11th.

questions.q: Which 2026 BRICS meeting was held in Nagpur?
questions.explanation: The booklet lists Nagpur, Maharashtra as the host city of the Transport Ministers' Meeting.

questions.q: Gucchi Marmik, the showcase used by India at the summit, featured which regional product?
questions.explanation: The booklet says India showcased regional products through Gucchi Marmik, which featured Himalayan Gucchi mushrooms.

quizzes.title: New Delhi Summit Basics
quizzes.passage: India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi in 2026, which marked its fourth chairship of the grouping. The chairship ran under the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability.' The summit closed with the adoption of a declaration that emphasised multilateralism and more equitable global governance. Through the year, a series of ministerial and sectoral meetings took place in several Indian cities. Their subjects included urbanisation, energy, transport and the work of chief justices. Several of the year's meetings were held in New Delhi, including the Urbanisation Forum, the Chief Justices' Forum and the Leaders' Summit. The calendar covered more than one state, as the host cities included places in Haryana and Maharashtra. The 2026 calendar, set out in the summit material, ran over several months of the year. The key outcomes were grouped under several headings. These included financial, economic and trade cooperation, taxation and customs cooperation, agriculture and food security, health and medicine, transport, logistics and climate cooperation, security, law and social cooperation, culinary diplomacy, and geopolitical mandates with global governance. The culinary diplomacy heading featured regional products shown during the summit. Earlier Indian chairships took place on several occasions before 2026. Earlier chairships also carried themes of their own.

questions.q: In which year did the BRIC concept emerge? (year)
questions.explanation: The booklet says 2026 marked 25 years since the BRIC concept emerged in 2001.

questions.q: What edition number was the BRICS Energy Ministers' Meeting in 2026? (number)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists the BRICS Energy Ministers' Meeting as the 11th.

questions.q: In which city was the BRICS Energy Ministers' Meeting held? (city)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists Gurugram, Haryana as the host city for the Energy Ministers' Meeting.

questions.q: In which year did India's chairship host the BRICS summit in Goa? (year)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists the 2016 summit as the 8th, held in Goa.

questions.q: In what format was India's 2021 chairship summit held? (one word)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists the 2021 (13th) summit as virtual.

questions.q: Which BRICS event was held in Mumbai? (name of event)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists the BRICS Friendship Cities Conclave as held in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

questions.q: How was the New Delhi Declaration adopted? (one word)
questions.explanation: The booklet says the summit concluded with the unanimous adoption of the New Delhi Declaration.

quizzes.title: Science and Digital Outcomes
quizzes.passage: The 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi carried a set of outcomes in science, technology and digital infrastructure. These outcomes covered satellites, digital public infrastructure, scientific collaboration, smart grids and entrepreneurship. Cooperation under the BRICS Remote Sensing Satellite Constellation was expanded at the summit. The chairship's theme included innovation, which the summit described as promoting new technologies, research and digital solutions for development. The theme also named resilience, which was described as strengthening countries' ability to deal with economic, environmental and geopolitical challenges. Among the named initiatives were a Digital Centre of Excellence for Smart Grids and a BRICS Incubator Network. Other items covered a network called GRAIN and the grouping's work on satellites. Both appeared within the science section of the outcomes. The key outcomes were grouped under several headings. These included financial, economic and trade cooperation, taxation and customs cooperation, agriculture and food security, health and medicine, transport, logistics and climate cooperation, security, law and social cooperation, culinary diplomacy, and geopolitical mandates with global governance. India was chairing BRICS for the fourth time in 2026, and the chairship ran under a theme built from four words. Science and technology items formed just one part of the wider summit agenda.

questions.q: GRAIN, for which an action plan was adopted at the summit, stands for which of the following?
options: Global Resource for Agricultural Information Network
questions.explanation: The booklet expands GRAIN as the Global Research Advanced Infrastructure Network.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): A BRICS DPI Repository was approved for creation at the summit.
Reason (R): Pilot projects were initiated for sharing open-source digital public goods.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.
questions.explanation: Both are booklet facts, but the pilot projects do not explain why the repository was approved.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Collective satellite data   ->   A. Disaster risk reduction and climate monitoring
II. GRAIN   ->   B. Pooling financial and intellectual resources for high-cost megascience projects
III. BRICS Incubator Network   ->   C. Entrepreneurship and innovation-led growth
IV. Digital Centre of Excellence for Smart Grids   ->   D. AI-enabled integration of renewable energy
questions.explanation: Each initiative matches its stated aim in the booklet: satellite data with disaster risk and climate, GRAIN with pooled resources, the incubator with entrepreneurship, and the smart grid centre with renewable integration.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The proposed BRICS Space Council has been formally set up as an operating body.
II. Collective satellite data is intended to support climate monitoring.
III. The BRICS DPI Repository was approved for creation.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Only terms were drafted for the proposed Space Council, so statement I is incorrect.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Digital Centre of Excellence for Smart Grids was established at the summit.
II. The BRICS Incubator Network was launched at the summit.
III. GRAIN is a grain trading exchange set up by the summit.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation: GRAIN is a research infrastructure network, not a grain exchange, so only the first two statements are correct.

questions.q: Pilot projects were initiated at the summit for sharing which type of goods?
questions.explanation: The booklet says pilot projects were initiated for sharing scalable, open-source digital public goods.

questions.q: Terms were drafted for a proposed BRICS council in which area?
questions.explanation: The booklet says terms were drafted for a proposed BRICS Space Council.

Digital public infrastructure featured in several parts of the outcomes, and the summit also recorded an approval relating to it. An action plan was adopted for one further network, and the outcomes listed it among the science items. Among the named initiatives was a Digital Centre of Excellence for Smart Grids. The science heading sat between the financial and health sections of the outcomes. The key outcomes were grouped under several headings. These included financial, economic and trade cooperation, taxation and customs cooperation, agriculture and food security, health and medicine, transport, logistics and climate cooperation, security, law and social cooperation, culinary diplomacy, and geopolitical mandates with global governance. India was chairing BRICS for the fourth time in 2026, and the chairship ran under a theme built from four words. Outcomes in this area were presented under their own heading, separate from financial and trade items. Science and technology items formed one part of the wider summit agenda.

questions.q: Which network, whose action plan was adopted at the summit, pools resources for high-cost megascience projects? (acronym)
questions.explanation: The booklet names GRAIN as the network whose action plan was adopted and whose aim is pooling resources for megascience projects.

questions.q: What type of energy integration does the Digital Centre of Excellence for Smart Grids support? (one word)
questions.explanation: The booklet says the smart grid centre supports AI-enabled integration of renewable energy.

questions.q: Besides digital identity, what other type of system was included in the pilot projects for sharing digital public goods? (two words)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists digital identity systems and digital payment systems among the pilot projects.

questions.q: What is the name of the network launched to promote entrepreneurship and innovation-led growth? (name)
questions.explanation: The booklet names the BRICS Incubator Network as launched to promote entrepreneurship and innovation-led growth.

questions.q: Which pillar of the 2026 theme promotes new technologies, research and digital solutions for development? (one word)
questions.explanation: The booklet defines Innovation as promoting new technologies, research and digital solutions for development.

questions.q: Collective satellite data would support disaster risk reduction and which other area? (two words)
questions.explanation: The booklet says collective satellite data would support disaster risk reduction, climate monitoring and wider access to space-based technologies.

questions.q: Which satellite-based cooperation under BRICS was expanded at the summit? (name)
questions.explanation: The booklet says cooperation under the BRICS Remote Sensing Satellite Constellation was expanded.

quizzes.title: Security and Global Governance
quizzes.passage: Security, law and social cooperation formed one of the main groups of outcomes at the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi. Under the counter-terrorism heading, the summit condemned cross-border terrorism, and the outcomes contained further items on corruption. Labour, social security and culture formed another heading, and the outcomes welcomed a cooperation network for capacity building, employability and new skills. Global governance was a further heading, covering reform of international institutions and proposals on how the international system should operate. India's framework seeks to move the international system towards a more inclusive model of global partnership. The outcomes also included a culinary diplomacy heading, under which India showcased regional products during the summit. India was chairing BRICS for the fourth time in 2026, and the chairship ran under the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability.' Overall, the outcomes were grouped under headings that covered security, science, finance, health and culture. The security heading sat near the end of the outcomes, after the science and health sections. The summit concluded with the New Delhi Declaration, which the outcomes described as emphasising multilateralism. The chairship also featured a series of ministerial and sectoral meetings across several Indian cities. The outcomes ended with a note on the next chairship.

questions.q: Which country was confirmed as host of the 19th BRICS Summit in 2027?
questions.explanation: The booklet confirms China as host of the 19th BRICS Summit in 2027.

questions.q: The summit's condemnation of cross-border terrorism also referred to which 2025 event?
options: A 2025 cyber attack on member states
questions.explanation: The booklet says BRICS condemned cross-border terrorism and the 2025 Pahalgam terror attack.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): BRICS adopted the UN Comprehensive Convention on International Terrorism at the summit.
Reason (R): BRICS urged progress towards the UN Comprehensive Convention on International Terrorism.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.
questions.explanation: BRICS only urged progress towards the convention, so the assertion is false while the reason is true.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Ezulwini Consensus and Sirte Declaration   ->   A. Greater African representation in a reformed UN Security Council
II. BRICS CONNECT   ->   B. Gig workers' rights and cross-border portability of social security
III. India's 3R Framework   ->   C. Representation, Responsiveness, Rule-making
IV. Ethiopia and Indonesia   ->   D. Expanded representation on the ICAO Council
questions.explanation: Each item matches its booklet description: the Ezulwini and Sirte texts with African representation, CONNECT with gig workers, the 3R Framework with its three terms, and Ethiopia and Indonesia with the ICAO Council.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. BRICS endorsed the WTO accession bids of Ethiopia and Iran.
II. China and Russia expressed support for India's and Brazil's aspirations for greater representation.
III. The 19th BRICS Summit is to be hosted by Russia.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statement III is incorrect because China, not Russia, is confirmed as host of the 19th summit.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. An expert network for tracing fugitive offenders has been established.
II. BRICS CONNECT is aimed at strengthening the rights of farmers.
III. The summit endorsed the Ezulwini Consensus.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation: BRICS CONNECT focuses on gig workers rather than farmers, so statements I and III are correct.

questions.q: The expert network for tracing fugitive offenders aims to facilitate recovery of what?
questions.explanation: The booklet gives the network's aim as facilitating recovery of illegally acquired national assets.

questions.q: Which country will host the 19th BRICS Summit in 2027? (country)
questions.explanation: The booklet confirms China as host of the 19th BRICS Summit in 2027.

questions.q: In which year is the 19th BRICS Summit to be held? (year)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists the BRICS Chairship 2027 as the year China will host the 19th summit.

questions.q: How many points are in India's roadmap for global governance reform? (number)
questions.explanation: The booklet describes India's proposal as a 10-point roadmap for global governance reform based on the 3Rs.

questions.q: Which country's WTO accession bid did BRICS endorse alongside Iran's? (country)
questions.explanation: The booklet says BRICS endorsed the WTO accession bids of Ethiopia and Iran.

questions.q: Besides Ethiopia, which country was backed for expanded representation on the ICAO Council? (country)
questions.explanation: The booklet says Ethiopia and Indonesia were backed for expanded representation on the International Civil Aviation Organization Council.

questions.q: Which UN convention did BRICS urge progress towards on counter-terrorism? (short name)
accept: UN Comprehensive Convention on International Terrorism

questions.q: BRICS CONNECT's capacity building covers employability and which other area? (name the area)
questions.explanation: The booklet expands BRICS CONNECT as a network for capacity building, employability, and new skills and technologies.
